PDI:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: one finished full-page portrait artwork for the six Hofstede dimension openers in an Italian university visual-design booklet. Output portrait 3:4.
Primary request: sophisticated artistic editorial illustration that belongs to the booklet's visual language: disciplined geometry, bold red shapes, charcoal-black silhouettes, precise curved routes, open circles and geometric architecture, generous pure WHITE negative space. Surreal graphic art and modernist screenprint composition, visually rich through scale, intersections and rhythm, with a very restrained fine ink grain only INSIDE colored shapes. The overall page must feel bright, crisp and contemporary, never antique or aged.
Color palette: ONLY chapter red #C10007, near-black #030712, neutral pale gray and pure white #FFFFFF. White is the predominant background and appears inside the illustration. No beige, ivory, cream, sepia, warm gray, parchment texture, torn paper, distressed edges or grungy woodcut. No extra color.
Composition/framing: One continuous edge-to-edge portrait artwork containing two equally weighted metaphorical halves, low pole LEFT and high pole RIGHT. A subtle meeting of forms at the vertical center, without divider or panel border. Upper 24 percent (especially top-left) stays pure white and free of objects for a later editable title. Main artwork runs across the whole width between 26 and 80 percent of the page and some forms are cropped by the lateral edges. Bottom 18 percent stays pure white and quiet for the two native pole labels and a caption. White is the actual background, not an outer frame or inset sheet. No text is generated: typography will be added natively in Figma.
Style constraints: artistic spatial collage with large architectonic shapes and elegant abstract gender-neutral human silhouettes when concept requires them; intentional simplified details and unexpected geometry. Not a statistical diagram, not a UI, not a logo, not a set of icons, not photorealistic, not glossy 3D.
Constraints: one artwork only, no lettering, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, borders, flags, charts or national stereotypes. Both poles carry equal dignity and similar visual emphasis. Preserve the left/right meaning and the visual metaphors specified below.
Input images: Image 1 is a STYLE REFERENCE ONLY showing the booklet's red, black, white, round markers, curved paths and precise graphical restraint. Image 2 is a SUBJECT REFERENCE ONLY for the previous Power Distance cover. Reimagine its metaphor in the new clean contemporary graphic style; do not retain its beige or antique texture or realistic landscape.
Subject: POWER DISTANCE (PDI). LEFT: five abstract human silhouettes share a large circular table and the same ground level, exchanging a single vivid red ribbon, evoking parity. RIGHT: five equally dignified silhouettes stand on architectural stepped terraces at different levels, connected by the same red ribbon, evoking accepted hierarchical distance. Keep the powerful contrast in horizontal equality versus vertical levels readable; simplify the landscape into interlocking white and black arches, circular counterforms, and crisp red paths. No vegetation or scenery unrelated to the metaphor. The table and stair architecture are substantial graphic art, not small pictograms.
